"2050500272 Rev:1.3" would appear to be silkscreened on [https://forum.openwrt.org/viewtopic.php?id=45607 WDR3600] :(v1.4/v1.5 boards) and perhaps some/all v1.2 boards (??). RAM and Flash may vary: 2x W9751G6KB-25 and W25Q64FVSIG is used on some units. The power adapter shown in the FCC photos for the ('''US''' sold, obv.) device is a :'''HuntKey''' HKA01812015-2K (100-240VAC ~50/60Hz, 0.5A -> 12VDC, 1.5A) The coaxial power connector on the device would appear to be an '''EIAJ-04'''. ==Links of Interest== [http://www.tp-link.com/resources/simulator/TL-WDR3600/Index.htm Firmware Interface] {{•}} [http://www.tplink.com/en/support/download/?model=TL-WDR3600&version=V1 Downloads] ===Firmware project forum posts / wiki pages=== *[http://www.dd-wrt.com/phpBB2/viewtopic.php?p=710430 On the '''DD-WRT Forums'''] *[http://wiki.openwrt.org/toh/tp-link/tl-wdr3600 On the '''OpenWrt''' Wiki] :The v1.1 unit shown has "2050500231 Rev:1.0" silkscreened on the board. ===Vendors=== *[http://www.amazon.co.uk/TP-Link-TL-WDR3600-Wireless-Gigabit-Storage/dp/B008QBAXI4 On '''Amazon.co.uk'''] :ASIN: B008QBAXI4 ===Other=== *[http://www.smallnetbuilder.com/other/ces-2012/31671-ces-2012-tp-link-announcements ''CES 2012: TP-Link Announcements'' on '''SmallNetBuilder'''] ==Flashing== {{Flashnotice}} ===Flashing dd-wrt=== {{DDWRT |techdata = |wikipage = https://wiki.dd-wrt.com/wiki/index.php/TP-Link_TL-WDR3600 |forumpage = |github = |target = |subtarget = |arch = |support_commit_id = |support_started_version = tl-wdr3600v1 build 20119 20121012 |current_supported_version = ?
